source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
The **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** Stratagem can target this unit even after being used on other units in the same phase. When it does:

- that use costs 1CP less
- that use does not stop other units from being targeted by that Stratagem in the same phase
- whenever the unit **declares a charge** while an **engaged** **PSYKER** unit of yours is up to 12" from it, you can let it re-roll its [Charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step); if you do, its **charge move** has to end in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit that is in Engagement Range of that **PSYKER** unit

openQuestions: The charge part is printed as an item of the list that follows the Heroic Intervention use, but it is worded as any charge this unit declares; the text does not settle whether it is limited to the charge that use allows.
